<DOCSTRING>
Removes a word from a given position in a puzzle grid.

Args:
    puzzle (list[list[str]]): The puzzle grid to modify.
    word (str): The word to remove.
    row (int): The starting row index of the word.
    col (int): The starting column index of the word.
    vertical (bool): Whether to remove the word vertically or horizontally.

Returns:
    None: This function modifies the puzzle in place and does not return a value.
</DOCSTRING>
